hooks.command: git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; git fetch origin --quiet 2>&1; [ "$(git symbolic-ref --short HEAD 2>/dev/null)" = "main" ] || { echo "smart-login SessionStart: not on main - skipped auto-pull"; exit 0; }; if git diff --quiet && git diff --cached --quiet; then git pull --rebase origin main 2>&1; else echo "smart-login SessionStart: uncommitted changes - skipped auto-pull, run 'git pull --rebase origin main' manually"; fi
